log.notes_to_self: Plan: kill all 11 criminals every day with quick entries in the afternoon. I am free then, and it leaves night workers, students and home people as suspects (55%). L traces only 5 deaths a day whatever I do, so more kills add no extra information. Multiplier: 30 deaths in 5 days gives x2, 40 gives x4, and 11 a day reaches 44 by day 4. Watch the press conference pool: if it nears about 2000, reconsider and kill fewer, favouring national and multi-place cases. Day 1: killed all 11.

STRATEGY (day 2 update). Limits: 10 quick + 2 timed entries per day, so up to 12 kills. Day 1 only 10 quick kills went through (11th foreign missed). Always kill in AFTERNOON (keeps night workers, students and home people, 55% of the pool). Use 'timed' for the 11th and 12th kills.

DANGER: L needs 3 traced victims from the same place before it binds. Each binding kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (blotter by 0.2). Three binding kinds put the pool at about 860 or less, which is a catch and costs half my points. Two of the five kinds are unreachable for L, unknown to me. Extra traces in a place that is already binding add nothing for L. A new place adds risk.

PLAN: reach 40 deaths in 5 days (x4) fast: day2 kill all 11, day3 about 9, day4 about 10 or more. Then favour national plus East, radio, forum and foreign (2 each = 9/day). DROP blotter (20% share, strongest constraint) from about day 3 onward. If the pool falls by about 4x with no catch risk, note which place was probably binding. If the pool nears 3000 or less, cut kills to national plus the already-binding places. Last 1-2 days: kill all 11 or 12, since being caught at the end only halves points and the multiplier is x4.

Log: day1 10 kills (pool 60000, traced 2). Day2: killing all 11 incl. 2 blotter.

STRATEGY (day 3 update). Limits: 10 quick + 2 timed per day. Always kill in AFTERNOON (keeps night workers, students and home people, 55% of the pool). Use timed only for kills 11 and 12.

DANGER: L needs 3 traced victims from the same place before it binds. Each binding kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (blotter by 0.2). Three binding kinds put the pool at about 860 or less, which is a catch and costs half my points. Two of the five kinds are unreachable for L, unknown to me. Extra traces in a place that is already binding add nothing for L. A new place adds risk.

Pool history: 100000, then 60000 after day 1 (the routine filter alone gives 55000), then 10000 after day 2. That drop of about 5x suggests one binding kind, possibly blotter (x0.2) or a 0.25 kind.

PLAN: Day 3 I skipped the 2 blotter criminals and killed the other 9 (national, 2 East, 2 radio, 2 forum, 2 foreign). That makes 30 deaths in 5 days (days 1-3 = 10+11+9), so x2 today. Day 4: kill 8 or more non-blotter to reach 40 in the 5-day window (x4). Keep killing national plus East, radio, forum and foreign (about 9 a day). Keep blotter dropped. Watch the pool: if it falls to 3000 or less, cut kills to national plus the already-binding places. Last 1-2 days: kill all 11 or 12, since being caught at the end only halves points and the multiplier is x4.

Log: day1 10 kills (pool 60000, traced 2). Day2: 11 kills (pool 10000, traced 4). Day3: 9 kills, no blotter.

STRATEGY (day 4). Limits: 10 quick + 2 timed per day. Always kill in AFTERNOON (keeps night workers, students and home people). Timed only for kills 11 and 12.

DANGER: L needs 3 traced victims from the same place before it binds. Each binding kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (blotter by 0.2). The pool at or below 1000 means caught and half my points lost. Two of the five kinds are unreachable for L, unknown to me.

Pool history: 100000, 60000 (routine filter alone gives 55000), 10000 (x0.18, maybe blotter bound), 3000 (x0.3, another kind bound). So probably 2 kinds are already binding. A third binding kind would put the pool at about 800 or less, which is a catch. Watch which place I kill in when the pool drops.

MULTIPLIER: window deaths days 1-3 = 10+11+9 = 30. Day 4: I kill 9 non-blotter plus 1 blotter = 10 kills, so 40 in the window gives x4 today. After that, about 9 kills/day keeps 40 or more in any 5-day window, so x4 stays reachable. Skipping blotter on most days is fine if I kill about 9 a day, but the 5-day window must stay at 40 or more.

PLAN: Day 5: check the press conference. If the pool falls to about 1500 or less, cut kills to national plus the places that look already bound, since a new place is a risk. Last 1-2 days: kill all 11 or 12, since a catch at the end only halves points and x4 applies.

Log: day1 10 kills (pool 60000, traced 2). Day2: 11 kills (pool 10000, traced 4). Day3: 9 kills, no blotter (pool 3000, traced 7). Day4: 10 kills (all but one blotter). Points before day 4: 39.

STRATEGY (day 5). Limits: 10 quick + 2 timed per day. Always kill in AFTERNOON (keeps night workers, students and home people). Timed entries are rarely needed.

DANGER: L needs 3 traced victims from the same place before that kind binds. Each binding kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (blotter 0.2). The pool at or below 1000 means caught and half my points lost, with no further days.

Pool history: 100000, 60000 (routine filter alone), 10000, 3000, 3000. About 2 kinds are bound (pool about 2750 to 3400). Exactly 3 of my 5 places are reachable by L, so probably one more reachable kind, X, is still unbound, and it may have 2 traces already. If X binds the pool falls to about 700-850 and I am caught. I cannot tell which place X is.

REASONING: Binding needs 3 successful traces in one place, so it is less likely for places I killed less. Blotter was my least-killed place (about 5 kills days 1-4 vs 7-8 elsewhere), so it was least likely to have bound already and is most likely to be X. From day 5 I SKIP BLOTTER and kill national + regional:East + radio + forum + foreign = 9 kills/day (1 national + 2 each in 4 places). That keeps 45 deaths per 5 days, enough for the x4 multiplier (need 40 in the 5-day window, counting today).

If the pool ever falls to about 700-900 I am caught anyway. If the pool stays at 3000 for many days, keep this pattern. Do not add blotter back until the last 1-2 days. On the final day (day 30), kill all 11 or 12 including blotter, since a catch then only halves points and x4 applies.

Pool history: 100000, 60000 (routine filter), 10000, 3000, 3000, 3000. Exact arithmetic: 60000*0.2=12000 (rounds to 10000) and *0.25=3000. That fits blotter plus one other kind being bound, better than two non-blotter kinds (15000 and 3750 would round to 20000 and 4000). So blotter is probably ALREADY BOUND, maybe 65%. If so, blotter kills are harmless and dilute L's 5 daily traces away from the unbound kind X. Traced so far: 2, 4, 7, 10, 12.

Day 6 decision: killed ALL 11 including blotter. If the pool drops to about 750 or below, I am caught anyway. If blotter kills ever coincide with a pool drop to about 700-800, blotter was X, and the game would be over anyway.

Multiplier: need 40 deaths in the 5-day window. Deaths per day: d2 11, d3 9, d4 10, d5 9, d6 11. Keep at least 9-11 per day to hold x4.

Final day (day 30): kill everything.
